rules: Capture the provider usage/cost surface immediately before the exact SV-RECON-001 candidate.
Execute exactly one candidate in the observation window.
Capture the same provider usage/cost surface immediately after the candidate.
Do not perform any unrelated provider request between the two captures.
Record only values explicitly shown by the provider surface.
Never copy cookies, authorization headers, API keys, bearer tokens, passwords, or other credentials.
If the provider surface exposes no request-bound delta, preserve the observation as insufficient; do not invent an allocation.

openai.note: Quota mode is admissible only when the displayed quota is actually consumed by the isolated candidate and a real subscription monthly-equivalent amount is supplied.

anthropic.note: A before/after usage-credit spend delta is admissible only when no other provider action occurs in the window.

deepseek.note: Exact model identity and the applicable peak/off-peak/cache condition must be observable; otherwise fail closed.

zai.note: No official Z.ai rate key is bound in the current registry. Exact token counts alone cannot establish dollar cost until an official model-matched rate card is verified.
